scope: Fresh independent NONAUTHOR review02 of all eight final candidate files, the full callable source path, test coverage, supporting evidence and acceptance boundaries. Source mechanism only.

priorBlockingFindingDisposition.evidence: Stop invocation and receipt persistence use separate exception handlers. Successful stop rc=0 survives receipt failure with stopReceiptPersisted=false and STOP_RECEIPT_PERSISTENCE_FAILED. Nonzero stop results and exceptions retain STOP_FAILED_AFTER_RETENTION. Exception class/detail are returned and saved when possible. exitRetained remains true throughout these outcomes. Operator regressions cover both cases.

checks.pins: Verified HEAD, manifest SHA256, all 49 manifest entries, all eight historical source-snapshot hashes, portable-copy hashes and final test/fault-injection receipt source pins; rechecked final manifest and files unchanged.
checks.callablePath: Traced retain_loan_main_exit through identity validation, explicit transport, parsing, terminal predicate, exclusive file creation, file fsync, directory fsync and subsequent stop.
checks.requiredBehavior: Canonical positive startup PID string and nonzero lowercase 32-hex InvocationID required. All 11 terminal fields must match. Not-found/default, mismatched, incomplete, malformed, duplicate and post-stop evidence fail closed. Running same-invocation returns NOT_TERMINAL before persistence or stop; later exited capture can use the same directory. Identity/show/persistence failures cannot reach stop. FINANCIAL_COMPLETE cannot establish process zero.
checks.boundaries: CLI refuses live collection. Explicit reusable transport is implemented. Caller startup, dedicated evidence directory, deadline, crash recovery, cleanup and containment-before-timer-cancellation obligations are documented. Resource, attempt, PCD, Preview and financial gates remain intact. No blocking source regression identified.
checks.reportedOfflineResults: Inspected hash-bound receipts reporting 25 passing unit checks and passing stop-receipt fsync-fault and timeout-detail checks. These were not independently rerun.
checks.startup: Loaded checked-in develop skill. status failed with sqlite3.OperationalError: unable to open database file. next returned sp01-loan-report with missing-evidence annotations; no dispatch followed.

limitations: Read-only policy provides no authorized writable temporary area; filesystem tests were not rerun and no workaround was attempted.
Controlled transports and retained historical observations do not establish live systemd behavior, admission, containment, financial acceptance or SP05 completion.

Author receipts report tool-free execution and absent process groups. First attempt reached 900 seconds with unknown usage; later terminal records report grok-4.6-build. This is not an immutable model checkpoint verification.
Author conversation/raw reasoning and the other current review02 verdict were not read. No edits, delegation, service/network/prover/wallet dispatch or historical execute-once execution occurred.
This verdict supplies only the Astra review02 approval; the separate current Opus approval remains required.
